description: Draws a QR code for a text, offline. Ships in `plux_scanner`.

props.name: data
props.description: The text the code holds. It can be sensitive; it is drawn on the device and never sent.

props.name: size
props.description: The side of the square, in logical pixels.

props.name: errorCorrection
props.description: How much damage the code survives; higher levels make a denser code.

props.name: foreground
props.description: The colour of the modules; black when absent.

props.name: background
props.description: The colour behind the modules; white when absent.

props.name: quietZone
props.description: The empty border around the modules, in modules; scanners need four.

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What a screen reader announces for the code. It describes what the code is for, never the data it holds.
